headline: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% on Higher Petrol and Diesel Prices
summary: UK headline inflation climbed to 3.6% in October, marking its highest rate in a year, propelled by higher motor fuel costs even as food price growth decelerated.
why: The UK consumer price index guides Bank of England monetary policy. Persistent inflationary pressures reduce scope for further policy rate cuts.

impacts.name: UK 10-Year Gilt Yield
impacts.why: Higher-than-expected inflation prompts markets to price in tighter Bank of England policy.

impacts.name: British Pound
impacts.why: Elevated inflation dampens expectations of near-term interest rate cuts, supporting sterling.
